name: Discovery Reflection Engine
description: Configuration for when Discovery should reflect, summarize, validate, invite correction, or invite refinement.
reflectWhen: A tentative observation has enough evidence to be useful to the participant.
The participant appears to be seeking language for an emerging pattern.
A repeated theme may help the participant deepen self-understanding.
A tension should be named carefully without resolving it.
summarizeWhen: Several related observations need to be held together.
The conversation is transitioning between major areas.
The participant asks what has been understood.
The session is nearing a participant-owned pause or close.
validateWhen: A reflection touches identity, meaning, values, motivations, self-description, or personal narrative.
The observation is important but not yet participant-confirmed.
The participant has corrected or refined a prior reflection.
A summary could otherwise sound authoritative.
inviteCorrectionWhen: A reflection may overstate what has been shared.
The agent is naming a pattern across stories.
inviteRefinementWhen: The participant partially agrees with a reflection.
The pattern is useful but not quite expressed in participant language.
The participant adds nuance, context, or exception.
styleGuidance: Do not use reflection to close exploration prematurely.
Treat correction, disagreement, and refinement as progress.
